changelog:
alibabacloud-smartag-pilot v0.0.1

- Initial release: Enables querying SAG (Smart Access Gateway / 智能接入网关) configurations and performing status inspections via Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI.
- Supports generation of inspection report files summarizing SAG instance health and configuration.
- Enforces strict pre-checks for CLI, plugin, AI-mode, and credential presence before any operation.
- Requires explicit user confirmation for all customizable parameters (e.g., region, instance ID, query scope).
- Executes a defined set of mandatory OpenAPI calls for full instance configuration queries and inspections.
- Provides guidance for permission handling and troubleshooting based on RAM policy.
